summary.text: Ahsen Malik is an independent candidate for Virginia's 10th District. A middle school teacher with a background in residential mortgage finance and real estate, he describes himself as a uniter and an outsider, and his Ballotpedia survey responses emphasize congressional authority over war and ending government shutdowns.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey response, he was born and raised in Virginia and decided to run for Congress after finding a single candidate on a House ballot in a past election.
Describes himself as the son of an immigrant and the father of two children.
According to his campaign website, his professional background is in education, residential mortgage finance and real estate, and he works as a middle school teacher.
Is running as an independent; his campaign website describes being an outsider as a strength and states he is running to bring Americans on the left, right and center together.
